name: drawful-animate
title: Flicker Frames
description: Create two-frame animations that loop forever! Draw your action prompt, then watch the flickering masterpiece as others try to guess what's happening.
instructions: Draw two frames of animation based on your action prompt. Others will see your flickering animation and write fake titles. Can you make them guess right?

amen.title: Illustrated Scripture
amen.description: Bring Bible scenes to life with two-frame animations! Draw, watch, and vote for the best.
